papers.title: Iris: Breaking GUI Complexity with Adaptive Focus and Self-Refining
papers.authors: Zhiqi Ge, Juncheng Li, Xinglei Pang, Minghe Gao, Kaihang Pan, Wang Lin, Hao Fei, Wenqiao Zhang, Siliang Tang, Yueting Zhuang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University (作者1-6,8-10), National University of Singapore (作者7)
papers.intro: 本文提出Iris，一个通过信息敏感裁剪（ISC）自适应分配计算资源，并利用自精炼双学习（SRDL）以无额外标注方式迭代提升GUI指代与定位能力的视觉代理基础模型。

papers.title: Falcon-UI: Understanding GUI Before Following User Instructions
papers.authors: Huawen Shen, Chang Liu, Gengluo Li, Xinlong Wang, Yu Zhou, Can Ma, Xiangyang Ji
papers.affiliations: 1 Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences；2 VCIP & TMCC & DISSec, College of Computer Science, Nankai University；3 Department of Automation, Tsinghua University；4 Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence；5 School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出一种解耦指令与GUI上下文的训练范式，通过全自动生成的指令无关数据集Insight-UI对模型进行GUI理解预训练，再微调指令跟随，构建的Falcon-UI（7B参数）在多个基准上达到与72B Qwen2VL相当的性能，验证了GUI上下文理解的重要性。

papers.title: Aguvis: Unified Pure Vision Agents for Autonomous GUI Interaction
papers.authors: Yiheng Xu, Zekun Wang, Junli Wang, Dunjie Lu, Tianbao Xie, Amrita Saha, Doyen Sahoo, Tao Yu, Caiming Xiong
papers.affiliations: Hong Kong University (Yiheng Xu, Zekun Wang, Junli Wang, Dunjie Lu, Tianbao Xie, Tao Yu); Salesforce Research (Amrita Saha, Doyen Sahoo, Caiming Xiong)
papers.intro: 提出了Aguvis，一个统一的纯视觉框架，通过直接操作屏幕图像、标准化跨平台交互和内在独白结构化推理，实现了离线与在线基准上的最先进性能，且无需闭源模型。

papers.title: VERA: Explainable Video Anomaly Detection via Verbalized Learning of Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Muchao Ye, Weiyang Liu, Pan He
papers.affiliations: The University of Iowa; Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen; Auburn University
papers.intro: VERA提出了一种基于言语化学习（Verbalized Learning）的框架，通过数据驱动地学习一组可解释的引导问题，使冻结的VLM无需指令微调或外部推理模块即可完成视频异常检测并提供解释。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Brained GUI Agents: A Survey
papers.authors: Chaoyun Zhang, Shilin He, Jiaxu Qian, Bowen Li, Liqun Li, Si Qin, Yu Kang, Minghua Ma, Guyue Liu, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang, Qi Zhang
papers.affiliations: Microsoft; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory; Peking University
papers.intro: 这篇综述全面梳理了以LLM为核心的GUI智能体领域，从演化历史到组件设计、框架、数据、模型、评估及实际应用，并提供了构建指南和未来路线图。

papers.title: ShowUI: One Vision-Language-Action Model for GUI Visual Agent
papers.authors: Kevin Qinghong Lin, Linjie Li, Difei Gao, Zhengyuan Yang, Shiwei Wu, Zechen Bai, Weixian Lei, Lijuan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.affiliations: Show Lab, National University of Singapore; Microsoft
papers.intro: ShowUI是一个基于Qwen2-VL-2B的轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，通过UI引导的视觉令牌选择、交织的VLA流和高品质小规模指令数据集，在零样本截图定位上达到75.1%准确率，同时减少33%视觉令牌并加速训练1.4倍。

papers.title: AdaptAgent: Adapting Multimodal Web Agents with Few-Shot Learning from Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Gaurav Verma, Rachneet Kaur, Nishan Srishankar, Zhen Zeng, Tucker Balch, Manuela Veloso
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology（Gaurav Verma）；J.P. Morgan AI Research（Rachneet Kaur, Nishan Srishankar, Zhen Zeng, Tucker Balch, Manuela Veloso）
papers.intro: 提出AdaptAgent框架，通过仅1-2次人类演示的上下文学习（专有模型）或元学习（开源模型），使多模态网页代理能够显著适应未见过的网站和领域，任务成功率绝对提升3.36%-7.21%，相对提升21.03%-65.75%。

papers.title: GUI Agents with Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.authors: Shuai Wang, Weiwen Liu, Jingxuan Chen, Yuqi Zhou, Weinan Gan, Xingshan Zeng, Yuhan Che, Shuai Yu, Xinlong Hao, Kun Shao, Bin Wang, Chuhan Wu, Yasheng Wang, Ruiming Tang, Jianye Hao
papers.affiliations: Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab, Renmin University of China
papers.intro: 本文对基于大语言模型和多模态大语言模型的图形用户界面智能体进行了全面综述，系统总结了数据资源、统一框架、分类体系及商业应用，并指出了关键挑战和未来方向。

papers.title: Attacking Vision-Language Computer Agents via Pop-ups
papers.authors: Yanzhe Zhang, Tao Yu, Diyi Yang
papers.affiliations: Georgia Tech（Yanzhe Zhang），The University of Hong Kong（Tao Yu），Stanford University（Diyi Yang）
papers.intro: 本文展示了VLM代理极易被一组精心设计的对抗性弹窗攻击，平均攻击成功率达86%，任务成功率下降47%，且基本防御措施无效。

papers.title: OS-ATLAS: A Foundation Action Model for Generalist GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhiyong Wu, Zhenyu Wu, Fangzhi Xu, Yian Wang, Qiushi Sun, Chengyou Jia, Kanzhi Cheng, Zichen Ding, Liheng Chen, Paul Pu Liang, Yu Qiao
papers.tags: object detection, scene understanding, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: 上海人工智能实验室、上海交通大学、香港大学、麻省理工学院
papers.intro: 本文提出OS-Atlas，一个通过多平台GUI定位预训练和统一动作空间微调构建的基础动作模型，在跨六个基准测试的移动、桌面和网页平台上显著超越现有开源和商业模型，实现了强大的OOD泛化能力。

papers.title: AutoGLM: Autonomous Foundation Agents for GUIs
papers.authors: Xiao Liu, Bo Qin, Dongzhu Liang, Guang Dong, Hanyu Lai, Hanchen Zhang, Hanlin Zhao, Iat Long Iong, Jiadai Sun, Jiaqi Wang, Junjie Gao, Junjun Shan, Kangning Liu, Shudan Zhang, Shuntian Yao, Siyi Cheng, Wentao Yao, Wenyi Zhao, Xinghan Liu, Xinyi Liu, Xinying Chen, Xinyue Yang, Yang Yang, Yifan Xu, Yu Yang, Yujia Wang, Yulin Xu, Zehan Qi, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, object detection, gui
papers.affiliations: Zhipu AI, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: AutoGLM是ChatGLM家族的新系列，通过中间接口设计分离规划与接地行为，并采用自进化在线课程强化学习，实现了在Web浏览器和Android设备上卓越的自主GUI控制性能。

papers.title: AgentStore: Scalable Integration of Heterogeneous Agents As Specialized Generalist Computer Assistant
papers.authors: Chengyou Jia, Minnan Luo, Zhuohang Dang, Qiushi Sun, Fangzhi Xu, Junlin Hu, Tianbao Xie, Zhiyong Wu
papers.affiliations: Xi’an Jiaotong University, Shanghai AI Lab, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出AgentStore——一个可扩展平台，通过动态集成异构代理并利用带AgentToken策略的MetaAgent高效管理，在三个基准上实现了超过之前系统两倍的性能，向专门化通用计算机助手迈出了关键一步。

papers.title: Lightweight Neural App Control
papers.authors: Filippos Christianos, Georgios Papoudakis, Thomas Coste, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: Huawei Noah's Ark Lab; Tianjin University; University College London
papers.intro: 本文提出LiMAC，一种结合轻量级Action Transformer (AcT) 与微调VLM的门控架构，在移动应用控制中实现比大型模型（GPT-4o）和纯VLM方法更快的推理（快30倍）和更高的动作准确率（高40%）。

papers.title: YOLOv11: An Overview of the Key Architectural Enhancements
papers.authors: Rahima Khanam, Muhammad Hussain
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Huddersfield University, Queensgate, Huddersfield HD1 3DH, UK
papers.intro: 本文详细剖析了YOLOv11在骨干网络（C3k2、SPPF、C2PSA）、颈部（C3k2）和头部（C3k2、CBS）架构上的关键创新，展示了其在5个计算机视觉任务上的扩展能力，并验证了其相比前代在参数效率和检测精度上的提升。

papers.title: SPA-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for SmartPhone Agent Evaluation
papers.authors: Jingxuan Chen, Derek Yuen, Bin Xie, Yuhao Yang, Gongwei Chen, Zhihao Wu, Li Yixing, Xurui Zhou, Weiwen Liu, Shuai Wang, Kaiwen Zhou, Rui Shao, Liqiang Nie, Yasheng Wang, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: 1Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab; 2Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen; 3Tianjin University; 4AI Centre, University College London
papers.intro: SPA-Bench 是一个面向智能手机智能体的综合性基准，包含340个跨中英文、跨单/多应用、难度分层的任务，集成11种主流智能体，并提出无需人工干预的自动化评估流水线，通过7个指标对智能体的任务完成度和资源消耗进行全面衡量。

papers.title: DistRL: An Asynchronous Distributed Reinforcement Learning Framework for On-Device Control Agents
papers.authors: Taiyi Wang, Zhihao Wu, Jianheng Liu, Jianye Hao, Jun Wang, Kun Shao
papers.affiliations: University of Cambridge, Powersense Technology Limited, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, University College London, Tianjin University
papers.intro: DistRL是一个异步分布式强化学习框架，通过集中式训练与去中心化数据采集解耦，结合定制的A-RIDE算法，大幅提升移动设备控制agent在线RL微调的训练效率与任务成功率。

papers.title: Harnessing Webpage UIs for Text-Rich Visual Understanding
papers.authors: Junpeng Liu, Tianyue Ou, Yifan Song, Yuxiao Qu, Wai Lam, Chenyan Xiong, Wenhu Chen, Graham Neubig, Xiang Yue
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Peking University, University of Waterloo
papers.intro: 本文提出利用网页UI的访问树（accessibility tree）和文本大语言模型合成多模态指令数据，构建了7.3M样本的MultiUI数据集，训练后的模型不仅大幅提升网页UI任务性能（如VisualWebBench提升48%），还意外地泛化到文档理解、OCR、图表等非UI领域，验证了网页UI数据…

papers.title: MobA: Multifaceted Memory-Enhanced Adaptive Planning for Efficient Mobile Task Automation
papers.authors: Zichen Zhu, Hao Tang, Yansi Li, Dingye Liu, Hongshen Xu, Kunyao Lan, Danyang Zhang, Yixuan Jiang, Hao Zhou, Chenrun Wang, Situo Zhang, Liangtai Sun, Yixiao Wang, Yuheng Sun, Lu Chen, Kai Yu
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 本文提出MobA，一个基于MLLM的移动助手系统，通过引入自适应规划模块（包含反射机制）和多层面记忆模块，能够动态调整任务计划以适应真实环境上下文和动作执行能力，从而高效完成复杂移动任务。

papers.title: Agent S: An Open Agentic Framework that Uses Computers Like a Human
papers.authors: Saaket Agashe, Jiuzhou Han, Shuyu Gan, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
papers.affiliations: Simular Research
papers.intro: Agent S是一个开源的代理框架，通过“经验增强的层次化规划”（结合外部网络知识和内部记忆检索）与“代理-计算机接口（ACI）”，使多模态大模型（MLLM）能够像人类一样自主操作计算机GUI，在OSWorld基准上达到新最优。

papers.title: Navigating the Digital World as Humans Do: Universal Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Boyu Gou, Ruohan Wang, Boyuan Zheng, Yanan Xie, Cheng Chang, Yiheng Shu, Huan Sun, Yu Su
papers.affiliations: The Ohio State University（Boyu Gou, Ruohan Wang, Boyuan Zheng, Yiheng Shu, Huan Sun, Yu Su）；Orby AI（Yanan Xie, Cheng Chang）
papers.intro: 本文提出UGround，一种基于网络合成数据和LLaVA架构简单调整的通用视觉定位模型，并构建了迄今最大GUI视觉定位数据集，使仅依赖视觉感知的GUI智能体在多个基准上超越使用额外文本输入的现有最先进智能体。
